purpose: Convert cold visitors with the core product promise

responsive.phone: Hero screenshot/media sits at a fixed 360px height in a portrait-ish aspect ratio (tablet default; phone uses the bare aspect-[0.877573] value from the same rule set).
responsive.tablet: Media grows to a max-width of 1500px (tablet:max-w-[1500px]) with the portrait aspect ratio (tablet:aspect-[0.877573]); heading steps to tablet:text-h1-t; content gap narrows to 60px (tablet:gap-[60px]).
responsive.desktop: Media switches from a fixed aspect ratio to a fixed height (desktop:aspect-auto desktop:h-[923px]); content gap widens to 80px (desktop:gap-20); heading steps to desktop:text-h1 with desktop:text-body-l subcopy.
